own_solution.law: Relativistic cyclotron frequency f = eB/(2 pi gamma m), gamma = 1 + K/(m c^2)
assumptions: uniform constant B, no E field

notes: Checked certified answers: K=100 -> 16.527 MHz; K=160 -> 15.625; K=175 -> 15.414; K=230 -> 14.689. Differences in the 4th-5th significant figure (e.g. 16.5273 vs 16.5271) come from the MeV-to-J conversion (stated e vs exact eV) and are negligible. Minimal pairs TE2A4/T8739 and T836B/TAC96 share 75 MeV and differ only in attachment. T13DE and T30C5 are declared numeral-free controls, so my pass-1 low rendering_not_minimal flag is withdrawn.
